name: KeeperHub (ElizaOS Plugin)
description: KeeperHub onchain DeFi actions as native OpenClaw tools — 17 ElizaOS-style actions covering token transfers, wallet balance, ENS resolution, Chainlink price feeds, DeFi protocols (Aave, Uniswap, Lido), workflow generation & execution, x402/MPP payments, and ERC-8004 agent identity across 19 blockchains. Actions use the eliza_keeperhub_ prefix.
author: Dhruv Pancholi

apiKey.description: KeeperHub API key (kh_ prefix). Get from app.keeperhub.com -> Settings -> API Keys.

testnetOnly.description: Block all mainnet write operations. Read operations always work.

allowedChainIds.description: Allowlist of chain IDs for write operations e.g. ["84532", "11155111"].
